source_text: Regarding claims of reduced sexual pleasure or function, multiple systematic reviews of high-quality studies, including randomized controlled trials and cohort analyses, have found no adverse effects on sexual function, sensitivity, sensation, satisfaction, or pleasure post-circumcision, with some reporting equivalence or slight improvements in erectile function and reduced dyspareunia.
